strategyDescription: TypeScript computes title-token Jaccard candidate edges (>=0.2, top 30); one model call per edge judges same-concern; verified edges are merged by union-find into connected components; components of size>=2 become clusters (one describe call each), singletons are unclassified. Partition validated in TypeScript.
noveltyRationale: Prior model strategies used per-PR facets or open themes; this one uses model judgments on PR pairs only (edge verification) and graph connected components for membership, with no vocabulary or theme list. Non-model priors used labels, keyword rules or TF-IDF.
